CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_cats, SUM(CASE WHEN main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Car Electronics','Home Audio & Theater','Computers','Video Games') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_elec FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 4) AS avg_from_prc_all, COUNT(prc) AS n_prc, ROUND(AVG(prc_usd), 4) AS avg_from_prc_usd, COUNT(prc_usd) AS n_usd, ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 4) - ROUND(AVG(prc_usd), 4) AS diff, SUM(CASE WHEN prc<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_prc, SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_usd FROM items_g2
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) AS n_prc, SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) AS n_usd FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT ref_id, ttl, main_cat, prc, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(prc/100.0, prc_usd)), 6) AS avg_usd_union,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(prc/100.0, prc_usd)), 2) AS avg_usd_2dp,
       COUNT(COALESCE(prc/100.0, prc_usd)) AS n_priced,
       SUM(prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) AS usd_only,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN main_cat IN ('All Electronics','Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Car Electronics','Home Audio & Theater','Computers','Video Games') THEN COALESCE(prc/100.0, prc_usd) END), 4) AS avg_electronics_cats_only,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN prc_usd END), 4) AS avg_usd_col_only
FROM items_g2
